## The decision this serves

## Concept

Mixture models over capture areas; what a proportion is, and what it is not.

**The assumption that breaks first.** That a dominant proportion licenses naming the spot as that cell type.

## Failure mode

**What it produces.** Proportions get thresholded into presence and absence, and the section is reported as a cell-type map.

**The diagnostic that catches it.** Plot the full proportion distribution per spot; the second-largest component is rarely negligible.
